title: Rendlesham/Bentwaters cover-up and interrogations
place_text: RAF Bentwaters, Rendlesham Forest, Suffolk, UK

tellings.quote: No. OSI shows up in plane. HVT escort teams show up, haul everything away. People are sworn to secrecy.

plain: After the 1980 sightings of strange lights near RAF Bentwaters, an air base in Suffolk, England, used by American forces next to Rendlesham Forest, investigators from the Air Force Office of Special Investigations are said to have flown in, escort teams hauled everything away, and the people involved were sworn to secrecy. Jake Barber, a former helicopter pilot, tells this second-hand, citing a British figure he names as Lord Norton. If true, it would mean the incident was quickly covered up.
